I’ve used Hypic for a long time and used to absolutely love it. Unfortunately, with the recent updates, almost every useful feature has been moved behind a paywall.

The makeup and retouch tools used to have a good selection of free options, but now nearly all of them require a subscription. Even the filter section is almost entirely locked, leaving very little for free users.

I understand that developers need to make money, and I don’t mind some premium features. However, it feels like the free version has been stripped of most of what made the app enjoyable. It’s really disappointing to see so many features that were once accessible become unavailable.

I hope the developers consider bringing back at least some of the free tools and filters, because this used to be one of my favourite photo editing apps.

reviews.title: The update ruined everything
reviews.text:
This used to be my favorite app, but ever since the update it’s become the worst photo‑editing app I’ve ever used. They removed some of the best buttons and features just to force everything through AI—yet the AI constantly throws warnings and errors. Nothing works the way it should, and it was so much easier when you could simply edit things yourself.

It makes no sense to remove core features and replace them with something that barely functions. They could’ve kept the original tools and added new ones instead of breaking what already worked. They even claimed the app would revert when I canceled my subscription, but it didn’t. Whoever is making these decisions clearly has no idea what they’re doing.
